title: Certificate for an exact critical value of a Hecke L-function over Q(zeta_7)
description: Rigorous interval-arithmetic certificate (standard-library Python), exact algebraic checks, an independent floating-point cross-check, and the manuscript for the evaluation L_K(Psi,2) = (49/8)(I_0 I_1 I_2)^2 of a conductor-2 Hecke character of Q(zeta_7).
